description: DEPRECATION NOTICE: This package will be renamed to 'stylobot.ui' on June 1 2025. See https://github.com/scottgal/stylobot/blob/main/docs/migration-v7.md -- Real-time bot detection dashboard with SignalR and DaisyUI.
